name: BlockVectra
description: Multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC, indexed data, documentation, pricing and status. Docs and discovery need no key; indexed data requires a user key, while RPC access follows each chain's public policy. Endpoint: `https://docs.blockvectra.com/mcp` · [Setup](https://docs.blockvectra.com/en/guides/mcp-server/) · [Python docs example](https://github.com/blockvectra/agent-quickstart/releases/tag/python-mcp-docs-2026.11.06)
